bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a grant to the Como Community Center in the city of Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+COMO COMMUNITY CENTER; APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$995,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Como Community Center to construct, furnish, and equip improvements to renovate and repurpose the historic Como Congregational Church in the city of Minneapolis to serve as a community center, public meeting space, and auditorium available for public use. Up to $100,000 of this appropriation may be used to reimburse the Como Community Center for costs incurred after October 1, 2024, for this project. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a grant to the Como Community Center in the city of Minneapolis.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. COMO COMMUNITY CENTER; APPROPRIATION.

$995,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Como Community Center to construct, furnish, and equip improvements to renovate and repurpose the historic Como Congregational Church in the city of Minneapolis to serve as a community center, public meeting space, and auditorium available for public use. Up to $100,000 of this appropriation may be used to reimburse the Como Community Center for costs incurred after October 1, 2024, for this project. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

Up to $100,000 of this appropriation may be used to reimburse the Como Community Center for costs incurred after October 1, 2024, for this project. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
